Test Case Description: Verify rejection when using email already taken by another user
PreRequisites:
- User is logged in as staff01
- Another user (staff02) has email: staff02@weddingms.com
- Database has unique constraint on Email field
Step Expected Result: Profile form is displayed with current data
Test Case Expected Result: System detects duplicate email and shows error message. Update is rejected and original email is retained.

Steps to Perform: Change Email field to: staff02@weddingms.com (already used by another user)

Step Expected Result: Loading indicator appears, then error response

- Error message: 'Email đã được sử dụng bởi người dùng khác'
- No database update occurs
- User remains on profile page
- Original email is retained
- Form shows validation error
